summary: Tested the Marketplace 'Avvisami' feature end to end. Backend: 11/11 pytest pass (tests/test_iter133_marketplace_notify.py). Calling notify twice gives a single record. One org can flag several services. A non coming_soon or missing service returns 400. Notify works for a TEST_ org whose trial expired (read-only), while checkout and POST /events are still blocked with plan_readonly. A non-admin member (membership role 'user') can notify, and the org admin then sees notify_me true. Credits and marketplace_purchases do not change. Super Admin endpoints return 403 for org users. Switching a TEST_ service to available sets notify_status to brevo_non_configurato with notified_at null. Manual notify returns {sent:0, failed:N}. Frontend: desktop org cards show Avvisami on all 9 coming_soon cards. Clicking shows a toast, turns the button into a 'Ti avviseremo' span and does not open the detail dialog. The state survives a reload. The detail dialog's -detail button works and updates the card. Super Admin page: the count button, the interests dialog table, CSV export (correct headers and rows, BOM, ';' separator), the empty state with CSV disabled, and 'Invia avvisi in attesa' (shown only for available services) all work. Mobile 390px: tap works and the state changes, no horizontal overflow. All test data was cleaned up (interests, TEST_ services, TEST_ org and users). QA credit balance is unchanged at 97.

minor.issue: marketplace_interests has no unique index on (service_id, org_id, notified_at). update_one with upsert is not safe under concurrency: simultaneous clicks from 2 users of the same org can create duplicate records. A concurrent test with 6 threads gave 1 record, but this is not guaranteed. Add a partial unique index on {service_id, org_id} for notified_at null, or a unique compound index, and catch DuplicateKeyError.

Counts interest documents, not distinct orgs. If a service goes available, gets notified, and is set back to coming_soon, the same org can register again and be counted twice. Use $addToSet org_id, then $size.

integration_issues.issue: A success (green) toast 'Avvisi inviati: 0 · errori: 1' is shown even when every send failed (Brevo not configured). Use toast.warning or toast.error when sent==0 && failed>0, and mention that Brevo is not configured.

issues: The Avvisami button is 32px tall, below the recommended 44px touch target.
The floating iubenda cookie-preferences icon (bottom-left) partly overlaps the Avvisami/Ti avviseremo button of the last card when scrolled to the bottom. Add bottom padding to the page.
A service that is 'available' but not purchasable_now shows the 'Prossimamente' badge but has no Avvisami button. This can confuse users; consider a different badge, e.g. 'In attivazione'.

action_items: Add a unique index for marketplace_interests (service_id, org_id) for pending interests to remove the duplicate race
Show a warning/error toast instead of success when admin notify sends 0 and has failures
Optional: bigger touch target for Avvisami on mobile; bottom padding so the iubenda floating icon does not overlap the last card
critical_code_review_comments: WRITE_EXEMPT_EXACT is matched against the route template ('/marketplace/services/{sid}/notify') in _enforce_plan. Correct, and verified working for the read-only org.
GET /marketplace/services filters interests by notified_at null. After a successful Brevo send the flag disappears, which is fine because the service is then available.

admin_update starts _notify_available with asyncio.create_task without keeping a reference. The task could be garbage collected or its errors lost. Store the task or add a done-callback that logs exceptions.
seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_ services, a TEST_ org with expired trial, a TEST member user, and interests (some via real catalog cards for the QA org). All deleted afterwards; the marketplace_interests collection is empty again.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest tests/test_iter133_marketplace_notify.py (it cleans up after itself). BREVO_API_KEY is empty in preview, so notify_status becomes brevo_non_configurato. The member was simulated by inserting users and memberships (role 'user') directly in Mongo. Read-only mode was simulated with saas.trial_end in the past.
